title: MagicScrolls
description:
Adds scrolls that is alternative of potions.

Will be updated with more of scrolls, and better textures.
body:
Imagine: Instant potions... now there!

**MagicScrolls** - Alternatives of potions! It crafts more easily: four pieces of scrolls and one piece of... effect that you need! _(there is speed and strength only right now)_

To get pieces you need to find Scroll flower, and it gives you random pieces... (idk do flowers spawn in the world or not...)
